scope_of_use: Multiple myeloma, in combination with other anti-myeloma products (HEMADY indication). The PK values describe single doses in 'subjects'; the label does not say whether these were patients or healthy volunteers.

regimen.schedule: once daily on specific days depending on the treatment regimen
regimen.quote: The recommended dosage of HEMADY is 20 mg or 40 mg, orally, once daily, on specific days depending on the treatment regimen.

cmax_single_20mg_ng_ml.population: subjects (not further specified), single 20 mg dose
cmax_single_20mg_ng_ml.quote: Following a single HEMADY dose of 20 mg, the geometric mean (coefficient of variation, %CV) dexamethasone peak concentrations (Cmax) was 247 ng/mL (31%) and area under the curve over time to infinity (AUCinf) was 1271 ng.hr/mL (31%) in subjects.

auc_inf_single_20mg_ng_h_ml.population: subjects (not further specified), single 20 mg dose

tmax_h.quote: Following 20 mg dose of HEMADY, dexamethasone median time to peak concentrations (Tmax) was 1 hour (range: 0.5 to 4 hours).

half_life_h.quote: The mean terminal half-life (coefficient of variation) of dexamethasone is 4 hours (18%) and oral clearance (CL/F) was 15.7 L/hr following a single dose of HEMADY.

protein_binding_percent.quote: Dexamethasone is about 77% bound to human plasma proteins in vitro.

renal_fraction.value: less than 10% of total body clearance
renal_fraction.quote: Renal excretion of dexamethasone is less than 10% of total body clearance.

linearity.quote: The pharmacokinetics of oral dexamethasone were dose proportional between single dose of 0.5 to 40 mg.

itraconazole_strong_cyp3a4_inhibitor.study_population: not stated; single 4.5 mg dexamethasone dose
itraconazole_strong_cyp3a4_inhibitor.quote: Coadministration of itraconazole (strong CYP3A4 inhibitor: 200 mg once daily x 4 days) with a single dose of oral dexamethasone (4.5 mg) increased dexamethasone AUCinf by 3.7-fold
itraconazole_strong_cyp3a4_inhibitor.label_dose_modification: Avoid; if unavoidable, monitor closely for adverse reactions (section 7.1)

aprepitant_moderate_cyp3a4_inhibitor.study_population: not stated; dexamethasone 20 mg Day 1 and 8 mg Days 2-5
aprepitant_moderate_cyp3a4_inhibitor.quote: Coadministration of aprepitant (moderate CYP3A4 inhibitor: 125 mg on Day 1, and 80 mg once daily on Days 2 to 5) with oral dexamethasone (20 mg on Day 1, and 8 mg once daily on Day 2-5) increased dexamethasone AUCinf by 2.2 -fold on Day 1 and 5

high_fat_meal.quote: A high-fat, high-calorie (total 800-1000 calories: approximately 60% from fat, 25% from carbohydrate and 15% from protein) meal had no effect on AUCinf and decreased Cmax by 23% of a single 20 mg dose of HEMADY.

not_stated: Whether the 'subjects' were patients with multiple myeloma or healthy volunteers, and how many.
Volume of distribution, absorption rate constant and absolute bioavailability.
Repeated-dose exposure; effects of renal or hepatic impairment ("has not been studied").
A quantified effect of CYP3A4 inducers.
